reason: I've been burned by a registration-fee scam, and this is free with no fee to join and no Instagram login, so I'd sign in with Google and paste my next DM into it. Not much to lose, but I'm not paying for Pro until it actually gets me a paid deal.
objection: Will cafés and salons actually pay a 5K Kannada creator real money, or will it be the same 'free meal for a Reel' barter offers with a nicer screen? And Kannada creators always get paid less than English ones, so I don't see what changes that here.
would_change_my_mind: If a month goes by with zero paid invites, or if it ever asks me for money to get seen, I'd delete it. Seeing a real invite near me with the fee written down, like ₹2,000 for one Reel, would keep me on it.
